title: Bunion Correction Protocol

weeks.label: Week 1: Start Here
weeks.focus: Reduce toe crowding, restore mobility and begin realignment.
weeks.notes:
BASELINE (DAILY): Toe spacers (2 spacers); foot and toe stretching with great toe abduction.

HOW OFTEN? Daily, about 10–15 minutes.
weeks.editorNotes: Sheet: "Week 1 of 4", toe spacers marked "(Baseline)". The left column's Program Overview (4 Weeks), Baseline, Frequency and Time panels are written into focus and notes; the goals strip is in focus.

exercises.name: Toe Spacer Wear
exercises.whenToUse: Holds the toes apart so the great toe can start to sit straighter.
howTo: Wear 2 spacers daily.

exercises.name: Assisted Great Toe Abduction
exercises.whenToUse: Teaches the great toe to move away from the others, with your hand helping.
howTo: Gently assist the great toe away from the other toes.

exercises.name: Toe Splay & Spread
exercises.whenToUse: Opens up all five toes so they stop crowding each other.
howTo: Gently spread all toes apart, keeping them relaxed.

exercises.name: Great Toe Stretch
exercises.whenToUse: Lengthens the tissue that is holding the great toe in.
howTo: Use your hand to gently stretch the great toe into abduction.

exercises.name: Foot Arch Activation (Short Foot)
exercises.whenToUse: Wakes up the small muscles that support the arch.
howTo: Gently lift the arch without curling the toes.

exercises.name: Calf & Plantar Fascia Stretch
exercises.whenToUse: Takes the pull off the bottom of the foot and the back of the leg.
howTo: Stretch the calf and bottom of the foot (both sides).

exercises.name: Acupressure Mat (Underfoot)
exercises.whenToUse: Stimulates the sole of the foot.
howTo: Stand or gently shift weight on an acupressure mat to stimulate the foot.

weeks.label: Week 2: Longer Wear & Strength
weeks.focus: Increase toe alignment, improve foot strength and build daily tolerance.
weeks.notes:
THIS WEEK: Longer wear time, strength, and continued mobility.

TOE SPACER GOAL: Wear throughout the day; sleep in toe spacers (nightly).

HOW OFTEN? Daily, about 15–20 minutes (plus daily wear).
weeks.editorNotes: Sheet: "Week 2 of 4", toe spacers marked "(Ongoing)". Eccentric Heel Drops is highlighted on the sheet as the week's new work.

exercises.name: Toe Spacer Wear
exercises.whenToUse: More hours in the spacers, now including overnight.
howTo: Day: As much as possible (goal: 8+ hours).
Night: Sleep in toe spacers (6–8 hours).

exercises.name: Assisted Great Toe Abduction
exercises.whenToUse: Teaches the great toe to move away from the others, with your hand helping.
howTo: Gently assist the great toe away from the other toes.

exercises.name: Toe Splay & Spread
exercises.whenToUse: Opens up all five toes so they stop crowding each other.
howTo: Gently spread all toes apart, keeping them relaxed.

exercises.name: Great Toe Stretch
exercises.whenToUse: Lengthens the tissue that is holding the great toe in.
howTo: Use your hand to gently stretch the great toe into abduction.

exercises.name: Eccentric Heel Drops
exercises.whenToUse: Loads the calf and the back of the foot slowly, on the way down.
howTo: Stand on a step (balls of feet).
Rise up on both feet.
Lower slowly (eccentric) for 5–10 sec.

exercises.name: Calf & Plantar Fascia Stretch
exercises.whenToUse: Takes the pull off the bottom of the foot and the back of the leg.
howTo: Stretch the calf and bottom of the foot (both sides).

exercises.name: Acupressure Mat (Underfoot)
exercises.whenToUse: Stimulates the sole of the foot.
howTo: Stand or gently shift weight on an acupressure mat to stimulate the foot.

weeks.label: Week 3: Unassisted Control & Footwear
weeks.focus: Build foot strength, improve toe control and alignment, and add daily function (shoes, walking, standing).
weeks.notes:
THIS WEEK: Unassisted toe control, greater strength, and real-world integration (shoes and daily activity).

FOOTWEAR: Use shoes with a wider toe box to allow natural toe spread and alignment.

HOW OFTEN? Daily, about 15–25 minutes (plus daily wear).
weeks.editorNotes: Sheet: "Week 3 of 4", toe spacers marked "(Ongoing)". Unassisted Great Toe Abduction and Heel Calf Raises are highlighted on the sheet as this week's changes.

exercises.name: Toe Spacer Wear
exercises.whenToUse: All-day and overnight wear continues.
howTo: Wear toe spacers throughout the day (goal: 8+ hours).
Sleep in toe spacers nightly (6–8 hours).

exercises.name: Unassisted Great Toe Abduction
exercises.whenToUse: The great toe now moves on its own, without your hand.
howTo: Actively move the great toe away from the other toes without assistance.

exercises.name: Toe Splay & Spread
exercises.whenToUse: Opens up all five toes so they stop crowding each other.
howTo: Gently spread all toes apart, keeping them relaxed.

exercises.name: Great Toe Stretch
exercises.whenToUse: Lengthens the tissue that is holding the great toe in.
howTo: Use your hand to gently stretch the great toe into abduction.

exercises.name: Heel Calf Raises (Full Range – Slow Eccentric)
exercises.whenToUse: Full-range calf work, still lowering slowly.
howTo: Full range calf raises (both feet).
Rise up, then lower slowly (5–10 seconds).

exercises.name: Wider Toe-Box Footwear
exercises.whenToUse: Shoes stop undoing the work between sessions.
howTo: Choose shoes with a wider toe box.
Allow room for natural toe spread and alignment.
Wear daily for walking, training, and activity.

exercises.name: Acupressure Mat (Underfoot)
exercises.whenToUse: Stimulates the sole of the foot.
howTo: Stand or gently shift weight on an acupressure mat to stimulate the foot.

weeks.label: Week 4: Resistance & Daily Life
weeks.focus: Maintain alignment, build strength and control, and integrate it into daily life.
weeks.notes:
THIS WEEK: Long-term alignment, active toe control, and real-world integration.

KEY UPDATE: Use thin toe spacers inside large toe box shoes and continue daily wear.

FUNCTIONAL GOAL: Actively use great toe abduction during everyday movements (walking, standing, training).

HOW OFTEN? Daily, about 15–25 minutes (plus daily wear).
weeks.editorNotes: Sheet: "Week 4 of 4", toe spacers marked "(Ongoing)". This sheet has six cards, not seven: the Great Toe Stretch and the Calf & Plantar Fascia Stretch are not printed on it. Resisted Great Toe Abduction (Band) is highlighted as the change.

exercises.name: Toe Spacer Wear (Thin Option)
exercises.whenToUse: Thin spacers go inside the shoe, so wear carries through the day.
howTo: Use thin toe spacers in large toe box shoes.
Wear toe spacers throughout the day (as tolerated).

exercises.name: Resisted Great Toe Abduction (Band)
exercises.whenToUse: Adds light resistance to the movement the toe has learned.
howTo: Actively move the great toe away from the other toes with light resistance (band).

exercises.name: Toe Splay & Spread
exercises.whenToUse: Opens up all five toes so they stop crowding each other.
howTo: Gently spread all toes apart, keeping them relaxed.

exercises.name: Heel Calf Raises (Full Range – Slow Eccentric)
exercises.whenToUse: Full-range calf work, still lowering slowly.
howTo: Full range calf raises (both feet).
Rise up, then lower slowly (5–10 seconds).

exercises.name: Wider Toe-Box Footwear
exercises.whenToUse: Shoes stop undoing the work between sessions.
howTo: Continue using shoes with a wider toe box.
Allow room for natural toe spread and alignment.
Wear for all daily activities (walking, standing, training).

exercises.name: Acupressure Mat (Underfoot)
exercises.whenToUse: Stimulates the sole of the foot.
howTo: Stand or gently shift weight on an acupressure mat to stimulate the foot.

uncertain: The sheets name the same movement two ways in places: the Week 2 card is "Eccentric Heel Drops" while Weeks 3 and 4 call it "Heel Calf Raises (Full Range – Slow Eccentric)". Kept as printed on each week.

The checklist strip at the foot of each sheet uses shorter names than the cards above it (for example "Heel drops (eccentric)", "Wide toe-box shoes", "Assisted abduction"). The card names are used here; the checklist wording is on the sheet image.
Week 4 prints six cards, not seven: the Great Toe Stretch and the Calf & Plantar Fascia Stretch are not on that sheet. Transcribed as printed; Dr. Jared to confirm whether they are meant to continue.
Weeks 1–3 print "Toe Spacer Wear"; Week 4 prints "Toe Spacer Wear (Thin Option)". Kept as printed.
No cue on any sheet says which foot, or whether to do both. Kept as printed.
sourceNotes: Transcribed from Dr. Jared's four Bunion Correction Protocol sheets (Week 1 of 4 to Week 4 of 4), supplied November 2026. Panel text, dosages and card order follow the sheets; the left-hand Program Overview, Frequency and Time panels are folded into each week's focus and notes.
